descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Cozy Kitchen is a relaxing restaurant game for Meta Quest where everything is done with your hands.

COOK FOR REAL
Drop raw patties and ham into the pans and listen to them sizzle. The bar over the pan turns green when it is cooked - pull it out before it burns! Toss three chopped veggies into the pot for a bubbling stew and dip a bowl in to serve it.

CHOP AND STACK
Chop buns, cheese, lettuce, tomatoes and onions on the cutting boards, then build your dish on a plate. Every layer snaps neatly into place - bottom bun, patty, toppings, top bun. Extra toppings mean extra tips.

HUNGRY ADVENTURERS
Knights, mages, rangers, rogues and friendly skeletons walk in, wave hello, sit down and show their order in a bubble. Every order also hangs on the ticket rail over the pass window. Set the plate on their table and watch them eat, then collect the coins they leave and bring the dirty plates back to the sink.

CAREER OR FREE MODE
Career: every day adds a new dish - Burger, Cheeseburger, Veggie Burger, Stew, Ham Dinner and the Deluxe - customers come faster and you earn up to five stars. Serve back to back for combo tips.
Free Mode: no clock and no rush. Customers wait as long as it takes, every order is different, and every dish is unlocked from the start.

Controls: grip to pick things up, left stick to walk (click to hurry), right stick snap turn. No violence, no failing - just cooking.
